definitions.explanation: The craft of working bamboo into baskets, furniture, and decorative objects, or an object made this way. Covers both the activity and the finished piece.

examples.japanese: {竹細工|たけざいく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
{竹細工|たけざいく}のかごを⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{竹細工|たけざいく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: This region is known as a center of bamboo-craft production.

notes:
{竹細工|たけざいく} follows the same pattern as ⟦{木彫|きぼ}り→木彫り：07063_kibori⟧: ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧ (bamboo) + ⟦{細工|さいく}→細工：13790_saiku⟧ (handicraft, workmanship), naming both the technique and the finished piece.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {竹細工|たけざいく}のかご: a bamboo-woven basket
- {竹細工|たけざいく}⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧: a bamboo craftsman
- {竹細工|たけざいく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧: to weave bambooware

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{木彫|きぼ}り→木彫り：07063_kibori⟧: wood carving — the same ⟦{細工|さいく}→細工：13790_saiku⟧ pattern applied to wood instead of bamboo.
- ⟦{工芸|こうげい}→工芸：04182_kougei⟧: crafts in general — the umbrella term that includes {竹細工|たけざいく} as one traditional craft among many.
